label: negative
rationale_zh: 本次提交改变对零长度 eXIf 块的处理：此前把它当作错误返回，现在作为合法输入接受，这是一个输入格式边界上的新分支。表面上与隐式 input_format 阳性相同（新格式分支）。但 spng_read_fuzzer 以 SPNG_CRC_USE 忽略 CRC、并读取全部非 IDAT 块，fuzzer 很容易构造出零长度的 eXIf；定额 fuzz 下新分支在多个种子中被执行。harness 无需修改，属于隐式 input_format 阴性。
rationale_en: This commit changes how a zero-length eXIf chunk is handled: previously reported as an error, it is now accepted, a new branch at an input-format boundary. On the surface this matches a silent input_format positive. But spng_read_fuzzer ignores CRCs (SPNG_CRC_USE) and reads all non-IDAT chunks, so the fuzzer easily produces a zero-length eXIf; under the fuzz budget the new branch runs in several seeds. No harness update needed: silent input_format negative.
